source.name: ISO New England SMD hourly data, 2018

transformations: hour-ending labels converted to interval-start hours
clock shifted back 1h from Eastern Prevailing Time to the Eastern Standard Time ResStock uses all year
each hourly day-ahead price held flat across its four quarter hours, as day-ahead settlement does
buyer price = day-ahead LMP + 0.12/kWh delivery adder

modelling_choice.regime: export paid at wholesale, import paid at retail
modelling_choice.why: under net metering an export is credited at the retail price, so low equals high, the spread vanishes and a local market has no reason to exist. Pricing exports at wholesale is what creates the spread that a local market splits between neighbours.
modelling_choice.delivery_adder_note: a single flat figure standing for distribution, transmission and taxes, which in practice vary by utility and by rate class
